sanskrit_verse:
पुराणैर् धर्मवचनैः सत्यमाहात्म्यकीर्तनैः
अनृतस्यापवादैश् च भृशम् उत्त्रास्य साक्षिणः
transliteration:
purāṇair dharmavacanaiḥ satyamāhātmyakīrtanaiḥ
anṛtasyāpavādaiś ca bhṛśam uttrāsya sākṣiṇaḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: By recitation of Puranas, declarations of Dharma, glorification of Truth, and denunciation of falsehood, witnesses are profoundly stabilized in their testimony.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Satya and Dharma, not institutional position
Causation arises through consciousness-shaping discourse, not external coercion
Capacity-based responsibility is enhanced by exposure to Dharma-pramana
Restoration logic operates through re-alignment of witness-consciousness
Consciousness alignment is achieved via authoritative scriptural immersion
executable_legal_axioms: IF witness_consciousness ≠ aligned_with_satya THEN expose_to_dharma_narratives(puranas, smritis)
IF dharma_vacana_exposure_count ≥ minimum THEN witness_testimony_weight += integrity_factor
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court proceedings, the reliability of a witness shall be assessed not merely by procedural adherence but by the degree of saturation in Dharma-vacana and Satya-kirtana. Witness testimonies influenced by Puranic and Dharmic discourse shall carry greater juridical weight due to stabilized consciousness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana-based causality establishes that truthful witnessing emerges from exposure to Dharma-sanctioned narratives. The sequential unfolding (anupūrvaśaḥ) of truth in consciousness negates punitive oversight. Responsibility is proportional to the extent of Dharma-infused cognition. Non-punitive reality is upheld as the witness is restored, not punished, through alignment with Satya.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svādhyāya Integration Protocol for inconsistent witnesses
Assign Puranic Recitation Modules to recalibrate testimonial integrity
Implement Dharma Śravaṇa Immersion to restore witness capacity
Activate Sākshi Śuddhi Kriyā to realign consciousness with Satya
Deploy Māhātmya Śraddhā Enhancement to deepen commitment to truth
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Jurisprudential Authority. Dharma is restored through consciousness realignment. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
